Package loveletter.model

Class GameRound

java.lang.Object
loveletter.model.GameRound
public class GameRound extends Object
Manages a single Love Letter round, including setup, turn order, card effects, winner determination and round token awards.

The round uses the supplied Player objects and modifies their state as play progresses.

  • Constructor Details

    • GameRound

      public GameRound(List<Player> players)
      Creates and prepares a round with the first participant as the starting player.

      Uses the same setup as GameRound(List, int) with a starting player index of zero.

      Parameters:
      players - the two to four participants in turn order; must not contain null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if players is null or contains fewer than two or more than four participants
      NullPointerException - if a participant is null

    • GameRound

      public GameRound(List<Player> players, int startingPlayerIndex)
      Creates and prepares a round with the specified starting player.

      Resets each player's round state while preserving affection tokens, shuffles a new deck and sets aside one reserve card. In a two-player round, three additional cards are removed face up. Each player then receives one card.

      The participant order is copied, but the Player objects themselves are shared with the caller. The first turn is not started automatically.

      Parameters:
      players - the two to four participants in turn order; must not contain null
      startingPlayerIndex - the zero-based position of the starting player in the participant list
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if players is null, its size is outside the range of two to four, or the starting player index is outside the list bounds
      NullPointerException - if a participant is null

    • startCurrentTurn

      public void startCurrentTurn()
      Starts the current player's turn by removing their protection and drawing one card into their hand.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if a turn is already in progress, the round is over, or the player's hand already contains two cards

    • endCurrentTurn

      public void endCurrentTurn()
      Ends the current turn and advances to the next player who has not been eliminated.

      A player who has not been eliminated must hold exactly one card before ending the turn. The next player's turn is not started automatically.

      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no turn is in progress, the current player is not eliminated and does not hold exactly one card, or no active player remains

    • isRoundOver

      public boolean isRoundOver()
      Returns whether the round has ended.

      The round ends when at most one non-eliminated player remains, or when the draw pile is empty and no turn is in progress.

      Returns:
      true if the round is over, otherwise false

    • determineWinners

      public List<Player> determineWinners()
      Determines the winners of the completed round without awarding affection tokens.

      If only one non-eliminated player remains, that player wins. Otherwise, the players with the highest hand card value are compared by the sum of their discarded card values. All players still tied after this comparison win.

      Returns:
      an unmodifiable list of winners in participant order
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the round is not over or no non-eliminated player remains

    • awardWinnerTokens

      public List<Player> awardWinnerTokens()
      Awards one affection token to each winner of the completed round and marks the round as scored.

      Tokens can be awarded only once per round.

      Returns:
      an unmodifiable list of round winners in participant order
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if tokens have already been awarded, the round is not over, or no non-eliminated player remains

    • isWinnerTokensAwarded

      public boolean isWinnerTokensAwarded()
      Returns whether affection tokens have been awarded for this round.
      Returns:
      true if this round has been scored, otherwise false

    • playCard

      public void playCard(Player player, CardType card)
      Plays a card without a target or a guess.

      Suitable for Handmaid, Princess and Countess. Priest, Baron, King and Guard can also be played this way when no eligible opponent is available. Prince always requires a target.

      Parameters:
      player - the current player
      card - the card to play
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an argument or the card choice is invalid, or a target or guess is required
      IllegalStateException - if no turn is in progress, the player is eliminated or does not hold exactly two cards
      See Also:
      • playCard(Player, CardType, Player, CardType)

    • playCard

      public Optional<CardType> playCard(Player player, CardType card, Player target)
      Plays a card with the specified target and no guess.

      Uses the same rules as playCard(Player, CardType, Player, CardType), with a null guess. Guard requires the four-argument overload when an eligible opponent is available.

      Parameters:
      player - the current player
      card - the card to play
      target - the selected target, or null when no target is required
      Returns:
      the card revealed by Priest, or an empty Optional if no card is revealed
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an argument, card choice or target is invalid, or a guess is required
      IllegalStateException - if no turn is in progress, the player is eliminated or does not hold exactly two cards

    • playCard

      public Optional<CardType> playCard(Player player, CardType card, Player target, CardType guess)
      Plays a card from the current player's hand and applies its effect.

      The player must be the current, non-eliminated participant, hold exactly two cards and own the selected card. Countess must be played when held together with King or Prince.

      Priest, Baron, King and Guard require an active, unprotected opponent. If no such opponent exists, the card is discarded without effect and the target must be null. Guard also requires a null guess in that case.

      Prince requires either the player themselves or an active, unprotected opponent as its target. Handmaid, Princess and Countess require a null target.

      When Guard has a target, the guess must be a card type other than Guard. All other cards require a null guess.

      This method does not end the turn or award round tokens.

      Parameters:
      player - the current player
      card - the card to play
      target - the selected target, or null when no target is required
      guess - the card type guessed with Guard, or null when no guess is required
      Returns:
      the target's hand card revealed by Priest, or an empty Optional if no card is revealed
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if player or card is null, the player is not the current player, the card is not held, the Countess rule is violated, or the target or guess is invalid
      IllegalStateException - if no turn is in progress, the player is eliminated or does not hold exactly two cards

    • getAvailableOpponents

      public List<Player> getAvailableOpponents(Player player)
      Returns the non-eliminated, unprotected opponents of a participant.

      Excludes the supplied player and preserves participant order. This method does not check whose turn it is.

      Parameters:
      player - the participant whose opponents are requested
      Returns:
      an unmodifiable list of eligible opponents, or an empty list if none are available
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if player is null or is not a participant in this round
